cases.rationale: Control request for a sloped curb parked lighted vehicle; original beam aim and brightness determine observations, no legal outcome inferred.

channels.name: drv.standing_or_parked
channels.method: original parked activity review and body pose
channels.reference_frame: original parked subject at C276263 sloped curb
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original pixel review required

channels.name: sig.headlamp
channels.method: original post-tick lamp readback and pixel review
channels.reference_frame: original parked subject at C276263 sloped curb
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original pixel review required

channels.name: kin.velocity
channels.reference_frame: original parked subject at C276263 sloped curb
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original pixel review required

channels.name: rel.occupies
channels.method: original full footprint and curb lane readback
channels.reference_frame: original parked subject at C276263 sloped curb
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms sampling; original pixel review required

limitations: Low-beam request alone does not prove depressed or dimmed
Synthetic fixtures do not establish original physical beam or legal outcome

unresolved_judgment_calls: Depressed or dimmed requires original source and legal review
